boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UC San Diego traditions spanning campus celebrations, college competition, and Revelle College rituals.

cards.title: Watch the Watermelon Drop
cards.subtitle: Revelle Plaza and Urey Hall
cards.notes: Catch the last-Friday-of-spring-quarter gathering, then watch Watermelon Royalty drop a melon from Urey Hall’s seventh floor.
cards.short_summary: UC San Diego’s oldest student tradition turns a physics-class experiment into a spring-quarter finale.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego identifies the annual Watermelon Drop as its oldest tradition; it occurs on the last Friday of spring quarter and features a melon dropped from Urey Hall’s seventh floor.
cards.source_title: UC San Diego Keeps the Watermelon Drop Rolling
cards.access_notes: Annual event; confirm the current spring-quarter program and viewing arrangements before attending.

cards.title: Join Sun God Festival
cards.subtitle: RIMAC Field
cards.notes: Follow the festival’s official updates for the yearly music-and-art program and its campus event details before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A student-life festival with roots in 1984 that brings live performances and art to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego describes Sun God Festival as an annual campus music-and-art event with roots going back to 1984.
cards.source_title: Legacies Behind Sun God Festival’s 40-Year History
cards.access_notes: Annual event; programming, attendance rules, and any ticketing vary by year.

cards.title: Cheer for the Golden Shoe
cards.subtitle: Week 0 intercollegiate competition
cards.notes: See UC San Diego’s undergraduate colleges compete in field games, a choreographed dance, and a school chant for the Golden Shoe.
cards.short_summary: The eight colleges bring games, dance, and chants to one spirited Week 0 contest.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego Recreation states that each Week 0, its eight undergraduate colleges compete for the Golden Shoe through games, dance, and a school chant.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week 2025 REC Events: What You Need to Know
cards.access_notes: Presented during Week 0; consult UC San Diego Recreation for the current venue and participation details.

cards.title: Start with Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: Campuswide, start of the academic year
cards.notes: Use the official Welcome Week listings to choose college, campuswide, and department events as the academic year begins.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus welcome tradition designed for new and returning Tritons.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego calls Welcome Week an annual tradition for new and returning students, with activities hosted by each college and across campus.
cards.access_notes: Held at the start of the academic year; events and eligibility vary by program.

cards.title: Meet the Beach at Scripps Pier
cards.subtitle: Scripps Pier Beach
cards.notes: If eligible, secure the required wristband and join the Recreation-hosted beach event for campus-organized shoreline activities.
cards.short_summary: A Recreation signature event that takes new Tritons from campus to Scripps Pier Beach.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego’s 2025 event listing describes Meet the Beach as the 17th annual signature event for first-year undergraduate, graduate, and transfer students.
cards.access_notes: The 2025 listing required wristbands for full participation and limited the event to first-year, graduate, and transfer students; verify the current event rules.

cards.title: See the Revelle Anchor’s Daily Repaint
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Fleet Residence Halls, Revelle College
cards.notes: Walk by the Anchor near Fleet Residence Halls and look for its newly painted message, artwork, or event-related expression.
cards.short_summary: A Revelle landmark repainted daily with changing student expression.
cards.evidence_claim: Revelle College describes the Anchor, adjacent to Fleet Residence Halls, as a daily-painting tradition with changing colors, text, and event-related context.
cards.source_title: Events & Traditions at Revelle College and UC San Diego
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark near residential buildings; observe any posted campus or residential-area guidance.

cards.title: Follow Spirit Week to Spirit Night
cards.subtitle: Intercollege spirit competition
cards.notes: Look for the winter schedule of chalk, art, mini-games, and the culminating college competition for the Cup of Cheer.
cards.short_summary: A decades-running college-spirit sequence that culminates in the Cup of Cheer competition.
cards.evidence_claim: Revelle College says Spirit Week has been celebrated for over 25 years and leads to Spirit Night, where the colleges compete for the Cup of Cheer.
cards.access_notes: Winter-quarter programming; confirm the current schedule, venue, and participation options with Revelle College.

cards.title: Mark Roger Revelle’s Birthday
cards.subtitle: Revelle Plaza, Revelle College
cards.notes: Visit Revelle Plaza on the final Friday of winter quarter for the college’s celebration honoring namesake Roger Revelle.
cards.short_summary: A Revelle College birthday observance with music, food, and cake on the plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: Revelle College lists a final-Friday-of-winter-quarter celebration in Revelle Plaza honoring Roger Revelle, with music, barbecue lunch, and birthday cake.
cards.access_notes: Winter-quarter event; verify the current date, program, and attendance details with Revelle College.

cards.title: Celebrate Dr. Seuss at UC San Diego
cards.subtitle: UC San Diego Libraries
cards.notes: Watch UC San Diego Libraries for its annual birthday celebration, which the college tradition page describes with storytelling and Cat in the Hat appearances.
cards.short_summary: The campus library’s recurring Dr. Seuss birthday celebration reflects UC San Diego’s Geisel connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Revelle College states that UC San Diego Libraries annually celebrates Dr. Seuss’s birthday with music, storytelling, the Cat in the Hat, and refreshments.
cards.source_title: Events & Traditions at Revelle College and UC San Diego
cards.access_notes: Annual library event; check UC San Diego Libraries for the current date, location, and participation details.

cards.title: Float at the Triton Pool Party
cards.subtitle: Natatorium, Main Gym Complex
cards.notes: Plan around Week 0 and head to the Natatorium for Recreation’s annual pool party, with pool floaties, a spa, music, and light refreshments.
cards.short_summary: A Week 0 pool-party ritual that welcomes students with floating lounge space and Recreation programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego Recreation describes Floatopia as its annual pool party, held at the Natatorium pool in the Main Gym Complex during Welcome Week programming.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week 2025 REC Events: What You Need to Know
cards.access_notes: Week 0 event for students; confirm the current time, facility entry requirements, and availability with UC San Diego Recreation.
